title: 花样机与锁眼、钉扣、套结机控制
Control of Pattern Sewers, Buttonholers and Bartackers
goals: 能说明电子花样机的组成，以及 X–Y 工作台、中压脚、压框和剪线怎样与主轴配合。
Describe the composition of a programmable pattern sewer and how the X–Y table, intermediate presser foot, clamp and trimmer work with the main shaft.
能由针杆运动和布厚算出离布窗口 W，再由针距和轴加速度算出每针的转速上限 n_max = W/(6t_move)。
Calculate the off-fabric window W from needle-bar motion and fabric thickness, and the per-stitch speed limit n_max = W/(6t_move) from stitch length and axis acceleration.
能解释电子凸轮为什么以主轴转角为自变量、怎样补偿驱动延迟，比较三种运动规律，并用前瞻算法给一串针安排转速。
Explain why the electronic cam uses shaft angle as its variable and how drive delay is compensated, compare three motion laws, and assign speeds to a stitch sequence with the look-ahead algorithm.
能把轮廓编成花样文件（分段、等分、工艺针、排序、检查），并说明套结、钉扣、锁眼机是固定花样的参数化特例。
Turn an outline into a pattern file (segmentation, equal division, process stitches, ordering, checking) and explain bartackers, button sewers and buttonholers as parametric special cases.
能按峰值转矩、转速和均方根转矩为 X 轴选伺服电机，并说明控制箱硬件、剪线电磁铁驱动和软件分层的设计要点。
Size an X-axis servo by peak torque, speed and RMS torque, and explain the key points of control-box hardware, trimming-solenoid drive and software layering.

title: 口袋盖花样机：针距从 3 mm 改成 6 mm 以后断针
Pocket-flap pattern sewer: needles break after the stitch length goes from 3 mm to 6 mm
text: 某牛仔车间用电子花样机缝口袋盖装饰线，一个口袋盖约 60 针，主轴设定 2000 r/min，布加下模板总厚 1.5 mm。客户要求装饰线更粗犷，技术员把针距从 3 mm 改成 6 mm，转速没动，结果频繁断针。机器按第 15 章算例：针杆 r = 15.5 mm、l = 55 mm，上止点时针尖在针板上方 18 mm，离布窗口 W = 203.4°（布 + 下模板厚 1.5 mm；6 mm 厚时 170.5°）；每轴加速度 a = 50 m/s²，等加速等减速。

A denim floor uses a programmable pattern sewer for pocket-flap topstitching: about 60 stitches per flap, main shaft set to 2000 r/min, fabric plus lower template 1.5 mm thick. The customer wanted bolder stitching, so the technician changed the stitch length from 3 mm to 6 mm without changing speed, and needles began to break. The machine follows the Chapter 15 example: needle bar r = 15.5 mm, l = 55 mm, needle point 18 mm above the plate at top dead centre; off-fabric window W = 203.4° (1.5 mm fabric + template; 170.5° at 6 mm); axis acceleration a = 50 m/s², constant acceleration and deceleration.
question: 3 mm 和 6 mm 针距时每针的转速上限各是多少？为什么改针距后会断针，转速应降到多少？如果换成总厚 6 mm 的厚料、6 mm 针距呢？一个口袋盖的缝制时间约多少，提高转速对产能有多大意义？

What is the per-stitch speed limit for 3 mm and for 6 mm? Why did needles break after the change, and to what speed should the machine be lowered? What about 6 mm stitches on 6 mm-thick material? About how long does one flap take to sew, and how much does a higher speed matter for output?
answer: t_move = 2√(s/a)：3 mm 时 15.5 ms，n_max = 203.4/(6 × 0.0155) ≈ 2190 r/min，2000 r/min 可以；6 mm 时 21.9 ms，n_max ≈ 1550 r/min，2000 r/min 下模板在机针入布后还在动，所以断针，转速要降到约 1550 r/min 以下（或启用前瞻自动限速）。厚料 W = 170.5°，6 mm 针距只能到约 1300 r/min。60 针在 2000 r/min 下缝约 1.8 s，加剪线、空走和起停约 3.3 s，而人工取放模板要 8–10 s，所以产能主要受上下料限制，靠提转速收效很小。

t_move = 2√(s/a): at 3 mm it is 15.5 ms and n_max = 203.4/(6 × 0.0155) ≈ 2190 r/min, so 2000 r/min is fine; at 6 mm it is 21.9 ms and n_max ≈ 1550 r/min, so at 2000 r/min the template is still moving after the needle enters the fabric — hence broken needles; the speed must drop below about 1550 r/min (or look-ahead must limit it automatically). On thick material W = 170.5° and 6 mm stitches allow only about 1300 r/min. Sixty stitches at 2000 r/min take about 1.8 s, about 3.3 s with trims, jumps and start/stop, while loading and unloading the template by hand takes 8–10 s, so output is limited by loading, and higher speed gains little.

title: 电子凸轮、前瞻和电机选型：机器人轨迹规划的同一套方法
Electronic cams, look-ahead and motor sizing: the same toolkit as robot trajectory planning
text: 机器人跟随传送带作业（例如在移动的衣片上涂胶或缝合）时，把关节或末端位置写成传送带编码器读数的函数，这就是以主轴角为主令的电子凸轮；同样要用预测位置补偿驱动延迟，否则会落后。机械臂沿一条带尖角的路径运动时，控制器也要像花样机前瞻调速那样提前几个插补段减速，否则到了拐角才减速会超出关节的加速度能力。机械臂的点到点运动常用加速度连续的 S 形规律，原因和花样机选修正梯形、摆线规律一样：加速度跳变会激起臂的振动。给机器人轴选电机也按峰值转矩和均方根转矩两步核算，减速比的选择就是 15.8 节带轮半径问题的翻版：最优传动比使电机惯量与负载惯量匹配。

When a robot works on a moving conveyor (say, gluing or sewing a moving garment panel), its joint or tool position is written as a function of the conveyor encoder reading — an electronic cam with the conveyor as master, and predicted position must again compensate drive delay or the robot lags. When an arm follows a path with sharp corners, the controller must slow down several interpolation segments ahead, exactly like look-ahead speed control on a pattern sewer, or it will exceed the joints' acceleration capability at the corner. Point-to-point robot moves usually use acceleration-continuous S-curves, for the same reason a pattern sewer picks modified-trapezoid or cycloidal laws: jumps in acceleration excite vibration of the arm. Robot-axis motors are sized by the same two checks, peak and RMS torque, and choosing the gear ratio is the same problem as the pulley radius in Section 15.8: the best ratio matches motor and load inertia.

title: 跳大绳
Running into a long skipping rope
text: 两人摇长绳时，跳绳的人只能在绳子离开地面的那段时间里跑进去或换位置；绳摇得越快，这个窗口越短，一步迈得越大越来不及——这就是离布窗口、针距和转速的关系。

With two people turning a long rope, a jumper can only run in or change position while the rope is off the ground; the faster it turns, the shorter that window, and the longer the stride, the less time there is — just like the off-fabric window, stitch length and speed.

title: 引子：让模板带着布走
Opening: let the template carry the fabric
points: 口袋盖、肩带、鞋面、座椅装饰线：形状复杂但每件相同
Pocket flaps, straps, shoe uppers, seat topstitching: complex shapes, identical every piece
机头只管刺布；布夹在模板里由 X–Y 工作台按程序带着走
The head only pierces; the fabric, clamped in a template, is moved by the X–Y table
核心问题：工作台什么时候走、走多快、一针最多走多远
Core questions: when may the table move, how fast, and how far per stitch
narration: 口袋盖、肩带、鞋面、汽车座椅上的装饰线，形状复杂，可每一件都一样。让熟练工在平缝机上一边送布一边转方向，一件要几分钟，线迹还时好时坏。花样机把这件事拆开了：机头只管上下刺布，布料夹在模板里，由 X–Y 工作台按程序带着走，工人只要把布放进模板、踩一下踏板。问题随之变成三个：工作台什么时候能走、能走多快、一针最多能走多远。这一讲就围绕这三个问题，最后再看套结、钉扣、锁眼这些特例，以及控制器怎样设计和制造。

Topstitching on pocket flaps, straps, shoe uppers and car seats has complex shapes, yet every piece is the same. A skilled operator steering fabric on a lockstitch machine takes minutes per piece, with uneven results. The pattern sewer splits the job: the head only pierces up and down; the fabric is clamped in a template and carried by the X–Y table under program control; the worker just loads the template and presses the pedal. The questions become three: when may the table move, how fast, and how far per stitch. This lesson answers them, then looks at bartackers, button sewers and buttonholers as special cases, and at how the controller is designed and built.

title: 花样机的组成
Composition of the pattern sewer
points: 机头：刺布、挑线、钩线与平缝机相同，少了送布牙；直驱伺服 + 编码器
Head: piercing, take-up and hook as on a lockstitch machine, but no feed dog; direct-drive servo + encoder
主轴角 φ 是全机的时间基准
Shaft angle φ is the time base of the whole machine
X–Y 工作台 + 模板与气动压框代替送布
X–Y table + template and pneumatic clamp replace the feed
中压脚随针杆跳动；剪线、拨线、松线由电磁铁驱动
Intermediate presser foot follows the needle bar; trimming, wiping and release by solenoids
narration: 和平缝机比，花样机的机头少了一样东西：送布牙。刺布、挑线、钩线三个机构和第 2 章完全一样，主轴转一圈缝一针。上轴末端是一台带编码器的直驱伺服，编码器读出的主轴角 φ 是整台机器的时间基准，工作台移动、中压脚、剪线都是“主轴转到某个角度时做某件事”。送布牙的活由 X–Y 工作台接了：Y 横梁前后走，X 滑座在横梁上左右走，压框和模板装在 X 滑座上。普通压脚会挡住模板，所以换成随针杆跳动的中压脚。看这张爆炸图，各部分用颜色分开了。

Compared with a lockstitch machine, the pattern sewer's head lacks one thing: the feed dog. Piercing, take-up and hook are exactly as in Chapter 2, one stitch per revolution. A direct-drive servo with an encoder sits at the end of the arm shaft, and the shaft angle φ it reads is the time base of the whole machine: table moves, intermediate presser foot and trimming all happen “when the shaft reaches a certain angle”. The feed dog's job goes to the X–Y table: the Y beam moves back and forth, the X carriage moves left and right on the beam, and the clamp and template ride on the X carriage. An ordinary foot would block the template, so a small foot bouncing with the needle bar is used. This exploded view separates the groups by colour.

title: X–Y 工作台与同步带的弹性
The X–Y table and belt elasticity
points: 龙门式：X 轴只拖滑座和压框，Y 轴拖整根横梁连同 X 轴
Gantry: X moves carriage and clamp; Y moves the whole beam with the X axis
同步带轻快便宜但有弹性；丝杠刚但惯量大；直线电机动态最好但贵
Belts are light, fast, cheap but elastic; screws stiff but heavy; linear motors best but costly
算例：EA = 150 kN，L₁ = 0.3 m、L₂ = 0.5 m → k = 800 kN/m，m = 3 kg → fₙ ≈ 82 Hz
Example: EA = 150 kN, L₁ = 0.3 m, L₂ = 0.5 m → k = 800 kN/m, m = 3 kg → fₙ ≈ 82 Hz
周期 12 ms，与一针移动 15–20 ms 同量级：加宽带、减轻压框、用平滑运动规律
12 ms period, same order as a 15–20 ms move: wider belt, lighter clamp, smoother motion law
narration: 工作台是龙门式两轴：Y 横梁两端骑在导轨上，X 滑座在横梁上，所以 X 电机只拖滑座和压框，Y 电机要拖整根横梁连同 X 轴，Y 轴更重。传动三种：同步带轻快便宜但有弹性；丝杠刚度高但惯量大；直线电机最好但贵。同步带可以看成滑座两侧两根并联的弹簧。算例 EA 150 千牛，两段带长 0.3 和 0.5 米，刚度 800 千牛每米，3 公斤的运动质量，固有频率约 82 赫兹，周期 12 毫秒，和一针的移动时间同一个量级。移动一停，模板就晃，晃没停就入布，针位就不准。

The table is a two-axis gantry: the Y beam rides on rails at both ends, the X carriage on the beam, so the X motor moves only carriage and clamp while the Y motor drags the whole beam with the X axis — Y is heavier. Three drives: belts are light, fast and cheap but elastic; ball screws are stiff but high-inertia; linear motors are best but expensive. A belt is two parallel springs on either side of the carriage. With EA = 150 kN and belt lengths of 0.3 and 0.5 m the stiffness is 800 kN/m; with 3 kg moving, the natural frequency is about 82 Hz, a 12 ms period — the same order as one stitch's move. When the move stops the template rings, and if the needle enters before the ringing dies, the stitch lands off position.

title: 中压脚与气动压框
Intermediate presser foot and pneumatic clamp
points: 中压脚：入布前压下，出布后才抬起；抬起后模板才能动
Intermediate foot: down before needle entry, up only after exit; the template moves only when it is up
电子中压脚：步进电机设最低点，可按段改（PRESS 命令）
Electronic intermediate foot: stepper sets the lowest point, changeable per section (PRESS)
压框：过滤减压阀 0.5–0.6 MPa → 二位五通阀 → 单向节流阀 → 气缸 + 磁性开关
Clamp: filter-regulator 0.5–0.6 MPa → 5/2 valve → flow control → cylinder + reed switch
缸径 32 mm、0.5 MPa：F ≈ 400 N；压力不足，布在模板里慢慢溜
32 mm bore at 0.5 MPa: F ≈ 400 N; too little and the fabric creeps in the template
narration: 中压脚是套在机针外面的一个小圆环，由上轴凸轮经连杆驱动，和针杆同步跳。机针上提时它压住布，不让布被针带起来，否则线环形成不好就跳针。它的时序有两条硬要求：入布前压下，出布后才抬起；抬起以后模板才能动。厚料薄料布面高度不同，电子中压脚用步进电机设定最低点，还能由花样文件按段改。压框由 2 到 4 个双作用气缸压紧，回路是减压阀、二位五通电磁阀、单向节流阀、气缸。32 毫米缸径、0.5 兆帕约 400 牛。压力不够，布会在模板里一点点溜，线迹慢慢偏离槽中心。

The intermediate presser foot is a small ring around the needle, driven from the arm shaft by a cam and link, bouncing in step with the needle bar. As the needle rises it holds the fabric down so it is not lifted, which would spoil the loop and skip stitches. Two hard timing rules: down before needle entry, up only after exit — and only then may the template move. Fabric surfaces sit at different heights, so an electronic foot uses a stepper to set the lowest point, changeable per section from the pattern file. Two to four double-acting cylinders press the clamp through a regulator, a 5/2 solenoid valve and flow-control valves. A 32 mm bore at 0.5 MPa gives about 400 N. Too little and the fabric creeps in the template, the seam drifting from the slot centre.

title: 控制系统的三层
Three layers of the control system
points: 应用层：解析花样文件、前瞻规划、缝纫周期逻辑；每针一次
Application layer: parse the file, look-ahead planning, cycle logic; once per stitch
运动控制层（DSP/FPGA）：以主轴编码器为主令生成 X、Y 指令，按角度触发中压脚和剪线；0.1–1 ms
Motion layer (DSP/FPGA): X, Y commands from the shaft encoder; angle-triggered foot and trimming; 0.1–1 ms
硬实时：2800 r/min 时 1 ms = 16.8°
Hard real time: at 2800 r/min, 1 ms = 16.8°
机械送布链换成“编码器 + 软件”
The mechanical feed chain becomes encoder plus software
narration: 控制系统分三层。最上面是应用层，读花样文件、解析成针点，做前瞻规划给每针分配转速，管理从压框压下到回原点的整个周期，每针只算一次，慢几毫秒没关系。中间是运动控制层，用 DSP 或 FPGA，以主轴编码器为主令，在规定的角度窗口里生成 X、Y 位置指令，并按角度触发中压脚、剪线、拨线，周期 0.1 到 1 毫秒。这层必须硬实时：2800 转时 1 毫秒就是 16.8°，错过一次就可能断针。最下面是驱动层。平缝机送布由偏心轮机械锁在主轴上，花样机把这条机械链换成了编码器加软件。

The control system has three layers. On top, the application layer reads the pattern file into stitch points, runs look-ahead planning to assign each stitch a speed, and manages the cycle from clamp down to return to origin; it computes once per stitch, so a few milliseconds late does no harm. In the middle, the motion-control layer on a DSP or FPGA uses the shaft encoder as master, generates X and Y positions inside the angle window and fires the foot, trimmer and wiper by angle, every 0.1 to 1 ms. This layer must be hard real-time: at 2800 r/min, 1 ms is 16.8°, and one miss can break a needle. At the bottom is the drive layer. On a lockstitch machine an eccentric locks the feed to the shaft mechanically; the pattern sewer replaces that chain with encoder plus software.

title: 核心约束：机针在布中时模板不能动
Core constraint: the template must not move while the needle is in the fabric
points: 针尖高度 h(φ) = 18 − x(φ)；降到 t 为入布角 φ₁，升回 t 为出布角 φ₂
Needle height h(φ) = 18 − x(φ); reaching t gives entry angle φ₁, leaving t gives exit φ₂
窗口 W = 360° − (φ₂ − φ₁)
Window W = 360° − (φ₂ − φ₁)
违反约束：针孔拉大、线迹歪，重则机针被别弯撞梭尖断针
Violation: enlarged holes, crooked stitches, or a bent needle hitting the hook and breaking
narration: 平缝机的送布牙只在机针离布后才推布，这条规则由偏心轮安装角保证。花样机必须用程序遵守同一条规则：机针一刺进布，模板就得静止，否则轻则针孔拉大，重则机针被别弯撞到梭尖断针。窗口多大？用第 3 章的针杆位移 x，算例上止点时针尖在针板上方 18 毫米，针尖高度就是 18 减 x。设布加下模板厚 t，h 降到 t 是入布角，升回 t 是出布角，可动窗口等于 360° 减去两者之差。1.5 毫米时 203.4°，3 毫米时 192.6°，6 毫米时 170.5°。布越厚，入布越早出布越晚，窗口越窄。

A lockstitch feed dog pushes only after the needle has left the fabric, a rule guaranteed by the eccentric's mounting angle. A pattern sewer must obey the same rule in software: once the needle enters, the template must be still — otherwise holes are torn larger, or worse, the needle is bent into the hook point and breaks. How big is the window? Using the needle-bar displacement x from Chapter 3, with the point 18 mm above the plate at top dead centre, the needle height is 18 minus x. With fabric plus lower template t thick, h falling to t gives the entry angle, rising back to t the exit angle, and the usable window is 360° minus their difference: 203.4° at 1.5 mm, 192.6° at 3 mm, 170.5° at 6 mm. Thicker fabric means earlier entry, later exit, narrower window.

title: 走一针要多久
How long one stitch's move takes
points: 三角形速度曲线（s ≤ v²/a）：t = 2√(s/a)
Triangular profile (s ≤ v²/a): t = 2√(s/a)
梯形（s > v²/a）：t = s/v + v/a
Trapezoidal (s > v²/a): t = s/v + v/a
a = 50 m/s²、v = 1 m/s：v²/a = 20 mm，针距全落在三角形区
a = 50 m/s², v = 1 m/s: v²/a = 20 mm, so all stitch lengths are triangular
slides.formula: t_{move} = \begin{cases} 2\sqrt{s/a}, & s \le v^2/a \\ s/v + v/a, & s > v^2/a \end{cases}
narration: 知道了窗口，再看走一针要多久。每轴有最大加速度 a 和最高速度 v。短距离移动时还没加速到 v 就得减速，速度曲线是三角形，时间是 2 倍根号 s 除以 a；距离超过 v 平方除以 a，才是梯形。算例 a 取 50 米每秒平方，v 取 1 米每秒，v 平方除以 a 是 20 毫米，而花样机的针距在 0.1 到 12.7 毫米之间，全部落在三角形区。所以对花样机，最高速度 v 基本用不上，决定快慢的是加速度。3 毫米一针，时间是 15.5 毫秒。这个数一会儿就要和窗口时间比。

Now that we have the window, how long does one stitch's move take? Each axis has a maximum acceleration a and maximum speed v. Over a short distance the axis must start braking before reaching v, so the speed profile is a triangle and the time is 2 root s over a; only beyond v squared over a is it a trapezoid. With a = 50 m/s² and v = 1 m/s, v²/a is 20 mm, while pattern-sewer stitches are 0.1 to 12.7 mm — all in the triangular region. So for a pattern sewer the top speed v hardly matters; acceleration decides. A 3 mm stitch takes 15.5 ms, a number we will now compare with the window time.

title: 转速上限与图 15-4 的四个结论
Speed limit and the four lessons of Fig. 15-4
points: 针距越大转速越低：n_max ∝ 1/√s，针距 4 倍转速减半
Longer stitches, lower speed: n_max ∝ 1/√s; 4× the stitch halves the speed
布越厚转速越低：6 mm 比 1.5 mm 约低 16%
Thicker fabric, lower speed: about 16% lower at 6 mm than at 1.5 mm
斜向反而快：45° 每轴只走 s/√2，可高约 19%
Diagonal is faster: at 45° each axis moves s/√2, about 19% higher
2 mm 以下受机头限制（示例 2800 r/min）
Below 2 mm the head limits speed (2800 r/min in the example)
narration: 转过窗口 W 的时间不能小于走一针的时间，整理一下，n_max 等于 W 除以 6 倍 t_move。3 毫米、1.5 毫米厚：203.4 除以 6 乘 0.0155，约 2190 转。图 15-4 告诉我们四件事。第一，针距越大转速越低，n_max 和根号 s 成反比，针距变 4 倍转速减半。第二，布越厚越慢，6 毫米比 1.5 毫米低约 16%。第三，斜向的一针反而快，每轴只走 s 除以根号 2，转速高约 19%。第四，2 毫米以下受机头本身限制。

At shaft speed n, sweeping the window W takes W over 360 times 60 over n, which must not be less than the move time; rearranged, n_max equals W over 6 t_move. For 3 mm on 1.5 mm material: 203.4 over 6 times 0.0155, about 2190 r/min. Fig. 15-4 teaches four things. First, longer stitches mean lower speed: n_max goes as one over root s, so four times the stitch halves the speed. Second, thicker material is slower: about 16% lower at 6 mm than at 1.5 mm. Third, a diagonal stitch is actually faster: each axis moves only s over root 2, about 19% higher. Fourth, below about 2 mm the head itself is the limit.

title: 电子凸轮：按主轴角度而不是按时间
Electronic cam: by shaft angle, not by time
points: 主轴转速会变：起针慢、中间快、剪线前慢、负载波动
Shaft speed varies: slow start, fast middle, slow before trimming, load fluctuations
X、Y 位置写成主轴角的函数；主轴变速时同步自动成立
X and Y positions are functions of shaft angle; synchronisation holds as speed changes
每 250 μs：读编码器 → 算 τ → 查 f(τ) → 发指令；2500 线四倍频 0.036°
Every 250 μs: read encoder → τ → look up f(τ) → command; 2500 lines ×4 gives 0.036°
驱动延迟 0.5–2 ms：用预测角 φ + ωT_d 查表
Drive delay 0.5–2 ms: look up with predicted angle φ + ωT_d
narration: 主轴转速不是恒定的：起针慢、中间快、剪线前又慢，负载一变也会波动。如果 X–Y 按时间出发，比如上止点前 8 毫秒开始动，主轴一变速就错位了。做法是把 X、Y 的位置写成主轴角度的函数。主轴就是凸轮轴，X、Y 是从动件，f(τ) 就是凸轮廓线，只不过存在内存里，每针都可以不同。主轴变速，曲线形状不变，只是走完它的时间变了，同步自动成立，这就叫电子凸轮。要注意驱动延迟，0.5 到 2 毫秒，2800 转时 1 毫秒就是 16.8°，所以要用预测角 φ 加 ω 乘 T_d 去查表。

Shaft speed is not constant: slow at the start, fast in the middle, slow again before trimming, and it wobbles with load. If X–Y started on a time basis — say 8 ms before top dead centre — any speed change would misalign it. Instead, X and Y positions are written as functions of shaft angle. The shaft is the camshaft, X and Y the followers, and f(τ) the cam profile — stored in memory and different for every stitch if needed. When the shaft changes speed, the curve's shape is unchanged, only the time to traverse it changes, so synchronisation holds automatically: an electronic cam. Mind the drive delay, 0.5 to 2 ms; at 2800 r/min 1 ms is 16.8°, so the table is looked up with the predicted angle φ plus ω times T_d.

title: 选哪种运动规律
Which motion law to choose
points: 峰值加速度 a = C·s/Δt²
Peak acceleration a = C·s/Δt²
等加速等减速 C = 4：峰值最小、转速最高，但两端加速度突变激振
Constant acceleration C = 4: lowest peak, highest speed, but acceleration jumps excite vibration
修正梯形 C = 4.89、摆线 C = 6.28：两端加速度为零，更平滑
Modified trapezoid C = 4.89, cycloid C = 6.28: zero end acceleration, smoother
Cycloid: Δt grows by √(6.28/4) = 1.25, speed limit × 0.80
narration: 这其实是机械原理里凸轮那一章的问题，答案也一样。用时 Δt 走距离 s，峰值加速度都能写成 C 乘 s 除以 Δt 平方，只是系数 C 不同。等加速等减速 C 等于 4，峰值最小、转速上限最高，但两端加速度跳变，会激起模板和横梁振动，到位后要等振动衰减，前面的同步带 82 赫兹就是这个隐患。修正梯形 C 是 4.89，摆线 6.28，两端加速度为零，最平滑。换成摆线，在同样加速度能力下 Δt 要放大 1.25 倍，转速上限乘 0.8。工程上薄料小针距用硬规律争转速，大模板大针距用平滑规律换稳定。

This is really the cam chapter of the theory of machines, with the same answer. Moving s in time Δt, the peak acceleration can always be written C times s over Δt squared; only C differs. Constant acceleration has C = 4: lowest peak and highest speed limit, but acceleration jumps at the ends excite template and beam vibration, and you must wait for it to die after each move — that is the hazard of the 82 Hz belt. Modified trapezoid has C = 4.89 and cycloid 6.28, with zero acceleration at both ends, the smoothest. Switching to a cycloid with the same acceleration capability stretches Δt by 1.25 and multiplies the speed limit by 0.8. In practice: light fabric and short stitches take the hard law for speed; large templates and long stitches take a smooth law for stability.

title: 前瞻调速
Look-ahead speed control
points: 主轴每针只能改变 Δn，不能为一针长针突然减速
The shaft can change only Δn per stitch; it cannot brake suddenly for one long stitch
① 每针自身上限 cap；② 起针、剪线前限速；③ 反向扫描提前减速；④ 正向扫描限制加速
① each stitch's own cap; ② slow at start and before trimming; ③ backward pass to brake early; ④ forward pass to limit acceleration
算例：2 mm 针 2680 r/min，第 5 针 10 mm 只能 1198 r/min，Δn = 300
Example: 2 mm stitches at 2680 r/min, stitch 5 of 10 mm capped at 1198 r/min, Δn = 300
After look-ahead: 2398, 2098, 1798, 1498, 1198; without it 10 mm gets 12.7 ms but needs 28.3 ms → broken needle
slides.formula: c_i \leftarrow \min(c_i,\ c_{i+1}+\Delta n),\qquad n_i = \min(c_i,\ n_{i-1}+\Delta n)
narration: 一个花样里针距各不相同，每针都用自己的上限行不行？不行。主轴连同旋梭有惯量，每转只能改变有限的转速 Δn。所以控制器要先往后看几针，提前减速，算法和数控机床的前瞻插补一样：先算每针自己的上限，起针和剪线前再限速，然后反向扫描一遍，后面有慢针，前面就提前降；再正向扫描一遍，加速也不能太猛。看算例：2 毫米针距稳定在 2680 转，第 5 针是 10 毫米的长针，上限只有 1198。Δn 取 300，控制器从第 1 针就开始降：2398、2098、1798、1498，到第 5 针正好 1198。

Stitch lengths vary within a pattern; can each stitch just use its own limit? No. The shaft and hook have inertia, so speed can change only by a limited Δn per revolution. The controller must look ahead several stitches and slow down early, with the same algorithm as CNC look-ahead interpolation: compute each stitch's own cap, add slow limits at the start and before trimming, scan backwards so a slow stitch ahead pulls earlier ones down, then scan forwards so acceleration is not too harsh. In the example, 2 mm stitches run steadily at 2680 r/min and stitch 5 is a 10 mm stitch capped at 1198. With Δn = 300 the controller starts slowing at stitch 1: 2398, 2098, 1798, 1498, and exactly 1198 at stitch 5.

title: 花样数据与编程
Pattern data and programming
points: 文件头 + “命令 + ΔX + ΔY”记录；整数增量（0.1 或 0.05 mm），紧凑、不累积舍入误差
Header + “command + ΔX + ΔY” records; integer increments (0.1 or 0.05 mm), compact, no accumulated rounding
六步：取轮廓 → 分段 → 等分 → 加工艺针 → 排序 → 仿真检查
Six steps: outline → segments → equal division → process stitches → ordering → simulation check
等分：n = ⌈L/s⌉，实际针距 L/n；段端必须落针，否则尖角变圆
Equal division: n = ⌈L/s⌉, actual length L/n; segment ends must get a stitch or corners round off
空走（JUMP）前剪线；排序类似旅行商问题
Trim before a JUMP; ordering is a travelling-salesman-like problem
narration: 花样文件各厂格式不同，内容大同小异：一个文件头，加一串“命令加 ΔX 加 ΔY”的针迹记录，Δ 是相对上一针的位移，用整数存，单位 0.1 或 0.05 毫米。为什么用整数增量？数据紧凑，累加也不会产生舍入误差。从一个口袋盖轮廓到花样文件，编程软件做六步：取轮廓、分段、等分、加工艺针、排序、仿真检查。等分时针数取 L 除以 s 向上取整，实际针距是 L 除以 n，这样段端恰好落针，尖角不会被切成圆角。多段花样之间先剪线再空走，各段顺序决定空走距离和剪线次数。

Pattern-file formats differ by maker, but the content is similar: a header plus a string of stitch records, each “command + ΔX + ΔY”, Δ being the displacement from the previous stitch stored as an integer in units of 0.1 or 0.05 mm. Why integer increments? The data are compact and summing them never accumulates rounding error. From a pocket-flap outline to a file, the software does six steps: take the outline, segment it, divide equally, add process stitches, order the sections, and simulate and check. When dividing, the stitch count is L over s rounded up, giving an actual length of L over n, so a stitch falls exactly at each segment end and corners are not rounded off. Between sections the machine trims, then jumps; the section order decides jump distances and trim counts.

title: 模板、联锁与周期时间
Templates, interlocks and cycle time
points: 模板：PVC、亚克力或环氧板，激光切割；下片厚度计入 t，越薄越好
Templates: PVC, acrylic or epoxy board, laser cut; the lower sheet counts in t, so thinner is better
槽宽 = 中压脚外径 + 1–2 mm；封闭槽用错开开槽或连接桥；内侧贴防滑层
Slot width = foot diameter + 1–2 mm; closed slots need offset slots or bridges; non-slip lining
启动联锁：压框到位、气压正常、安全光幕无遮挡
Start interlocks: clamp in position, air pressure normal, light curtain clear
口袋盖约 60 针：缝 1.8 s，合计约 3.3 s；上下料 8–10 s → 双工位、自动上料
Pocket flap about 60 stitches: 1.8 s sewing, about 3.3 s total; loading 8–10 s → twin stations, auto loading
narration: 花样机的精度不只看电机，也看模板，模板设计是工艺的一半。模板常用 PVC、亚克力或环氧板激光切割，下片厚度要计入窗口里的 t，所以越薄越好。槽宽等于中压脚外径加 1 到 2 毫米，太窄碰中压脚，太宽布会鼓起来；封闭槽里面那块会掉，要错开开槽或加连接桥；内侧贴砂纸或橡胶防滑。控制器只在压框到位、气压正常、光幕无遮挡三个条件同时满足时才启动。再算一笔账：口袋盖约 60 针，2000 转缝 1.8 秒，加剪线空走约 3.3 秒，而人工上下料要 8 到 10 秒。所以瓶颈在上下料。

A pattern sewer's accuracy depends on the template as much as on the motors; template design is half the process. Templates are laser cut from PVC, acrylic or epoxy board; the lower sheet counts in the window's t, so thinner is better. Slot width is the foot diameter plus 1 to 2 mm: too narrow hits the foot, too wide lets the fabric bulge; the island inside a closed slot falls out, so slots are offset or bridged; the inside is lined with abrasive or rubber against slipping. The controller starts only when the clamp is in position, air pressure is normal and the light curtain is clear. Now a quick budget: a pocket flap is about 60 stitches, 1.8 s at 2000 r/min, about 3.3 s with trims and jumps, while manual loading takes 8 to 10 s. The bottleneck is loading.

title: 套结、钉扣、锁眼：固定花样的特例
Bartacking, button sewing, buttonholing: fixed-pattern special cases
points: 小幅面、少针数的花样机；只调长、宽、针数等参数
Small-field, few-stitch pattern sewers; only length, width, stitch count are adjusted
钢制花样凸轮 → 两台步进电机 + 程序（字面意义的电子凸轮）
Steel pattern cam → two steppers + program (an electronic cam in the literal sense)
参数化生成针点：套结先打底、再覆盖
Stitch points generated parametrically: bartack underlay then cover
锁眼切刀联锁：主轴停在上针位才能切；刀未回位不许启动
Buttonhole knife interlock: cut only at needle-up; no start until the knife is back
narration: 套结机、钉扣机、锁眼机是服装厂里数量最多的特种机。从控制角度看，它们都是小幅面、少针数的花样机，花样是固定几种，只调长度、宽度、针数。机械式的里面有一块大花样凸轮，换花样就换凸轮；电子式换成两台步进电机加程序，这正是字面意义上的电子凸轮。这类机器一般不存针点，开机按参数实时生成。套结先打底再覆盖，按这两个式子算针点，改参数就是不同尺寸。锁眼机的切刀是独立动作，必须主轴停在上针位才能切，刀没回位不许启动，这两个联锁用状态机实现。

Bartackers, button sewers and buttonholers are the most numerous special machines in a garment plant. From a control standpoint they are small-field, few-stitch pattern sewers with a handful of fixed patterns; only length, width and stitch count change. Mechanical versions carry a large pattern cam, swapped to change patterns; electronic versions use two steppers and a program — an electronic cam in the literal sense. These machines usually do not store stitch points but generate them from parameters at run time: a bartack lays an underlay then a cover, by these two formulas, and new parameters give a new size. A buttonholer's knife is a separate action: it may cut only with the shaft at needle-up, and the machine may not start until the knife is back — two interlocks implemented in a state machine.

title: 设计实例：X 轴伺服电机选型
Design example: sizing the X-axis servo
points: m = 3 kg, a = 50 m/s², r_p = 15 mm, μ = 0.05; 400 W: rated 1.27 N·m, peak 3.8 N·m
Peak: F ≈ 151.5 N, T_peak ≈ 2.37 N·m < 3.8: OK
Heating: T_rms ≈ 2.37 × √0.57 ≈ 1.79 N·m > 1.27: overheats
改带轮半径 10 mm：T_peak ≈ 1.67、T_rms ≈ 1.26 N·m，用转速余量换转矩余量
Pulley radius 10 mm: T_peak ≈ 1.67, T_rms ≈ 1.26 N·m — trading speed margin for torque margin
slides.formula: T_{peak} = (ma+\mu m g)\,r_p + J_m\frac{a}{r_p},\qquad T_{rms}\approx T_{peak}\sqrt{W/360^\circ}
narration: 每轴 50 米每秒平方，要多大的电机才做得到？X 轴运动部分 3 公斤，带轮节圆半径 15 毫米，候选 400 瓦伺服。第一步峰值：力约 151.5 牛，乘半径再加上电机转子惯量那一项，约 2.37 牛米，小于峰值 3.8，可以。第二步转速：1 米每秒只要 637 转，转速余量没用上，这是个信号。第三步发热：最坏每针都用满窗口，移动时间占 0.57，均方根转矩约 1.79，超过额定 1.27，连续高速缝会过热。改法之一是带轮半径改成 10 毫米，均方根降到 1.26，刚好合格。

So far we assumed each axis can deliver 50 m/s²; how big a motor does that take? The X axis moves 3 kg, the pulley pitch radius is 15 mm, the candidate is a 400 W servo. Step one, peak: the force is about 151.5 N; times the radius plus the rotor-inertia term gives about 2.37 N·m, under the 3.8 N·m peak — fine. Step two, speed: 1 m/s needs only 637 r/min, leaving the speed capability unused — a hint. Step three, heating: in the worst case every stitch uses the whole window, so the move fraction is 0.57 and the RMS torque is about 1.79 N·m, above the rated 1.27 — continuous fast sewing would overheat it. One fix is a 10 mm pulley radius, bringing RMS down to 1.26, just within rating.

title: 控制器的设计与制造
Designing and building the controller
points: 硬件三原则：强弱分区单点接地；编码器 RS-422 差分 + 双绞屏蔽；输入光耦、电感负载续流
Three hardware rules: separate power and logic with single-point ground; RS-422 differential encoder lines with shielded twisted pair; opto-isolated inputs and freewheeling for inductive loads
剪线电磁铁：24 V 吸合 6.9 ms 太慢；75 V 过压 1.37 ms，再 PWM 保持；48 V TVS 释放约 1 ms
Trimming solenoid: 24 V pulls in at 6.9 ms, too slow; 75 V overdrive 1.37 ms, then PWM hold; 48 V TVS releases in about 1 ms
软件分层：FPGA → 运动内核 → 缝纫状态机 → 规划 → 界面；安全判断两道保险
Software layers: FPGA → motion kernel → sewing state machine → planning → UI; safety checks doubled
制造测试：贴片与 AOI → ICT → 烧录与 FCT → 老化 → 整机联调
Manufacture and test: SMT and AOI → ICT → programming and FCT → burn-in → system test
narration: 最后看控制箱。硬件三原则：强电弱电分区、地只在一点相连；编码器走 RS-422 差分和双绞屏蔽线，丢一个脉冲电子凸轮就错位；输入光耦隔离，电磁铁、气阀这类电感负载要续流。剪线电磁铁的例子：线圈 6 欧、30 毫亨，吸合要 3 安。24 伏直接驱动要 6.9 毫秒，比窗口还长；75 伏过压启动只要 1.37 毫秒，吸合后改 PWM 保持；关断串 48 伏 TVS，约 1 毫秒释放。软件越往下越快越硬，安全相关的判断状态机查一次、硬件再独立切一次。制造上测试点和自测功能要在设计时就留好。

Finally, the control box. Three hardware rules: separate power and logic, with grounds joined at a single point; run encoder signals as RS-422 differential pairs on shielded twisted cable, because one lost pulse misaligns the electronic cam; opto-isolate inputs and give inductive loads such as solenoids and valves a freewheeling path. The trimming-solenoid example: a 6 Ω, 30 mH coil needing 3 A to pull in. Driven straight from 24 V it takes 6.9 ms, longer than the window; a 75 V overdrive takes only 1.37 ms, then PWM holds it; a 48 V TVS at switch-off releases in about 1 ms. Software gets faster and harder towards the bottom; safety checks are made by the state machine and independently cut by hardware. For manufacture, test points and self-test must be designed in from the start.

summary: 花样机用 X–Y 工作台代替送布牙，主轴编码器角度是全机的时间基准；送布这条机械链换成了编码器加软件。
The pattern sewer replaces the feed dog with an X–Y table, and the shaft-encoder angle is the machine's time base; the mechanical feed chain becomes encoder plus software.
机针在布中时模板不能动：离布窗口 W = 360° − (φ₂ − φ₁)，布越厚越窄；n_max = W/(6t_move)，t_move = 2√(s/a)，所以 n_max ∝ 1/√s。
The template must not move while the needle is in the fabric: W = 360° − (φ₂ − φ₁), narrower for thicker material; n_max = W/(6t_move) with t_move = 2√(s/a), so n_max ∝ 1/√s.
电子凸轮以主轴角为自变量，用预测角补偿驱动延迟；运动规律 C 越大越平滑、转速越低；前瞻算法反向、正向各扫一遍，提前为慢针减速。
The electronic cam uses shaft angle, with predicted angle compensating drive delay; larger C is smoother but slower; look-ahead scans backwards and forwards to slow early for slow stitches.
花样编程六步：取轮廓、分段、等分（n = ⌈L/s⌉）、加工艺针、排序、检查；文件用整数增量。
Pattern programming in six steps: outline, segments, equal division (n = ⌈L/s⌉), process stitches, ordering, checking; files store integer increments.
套结、钉扣、锁眼是参数化的固定花样；切刀、压框、光幕等联锁用状态机加硬件双保险。
Bartacks, buttons and buttonholes are parametric fixed patterns; knife, clamp and light-curtain interlocks use a state machine plus independent hardware.
X 轴电机按峰值、转速、均方根转矩三步选型；带轮半径用转速余量换转矩余量；产能往往受上下料而非转速限制。
Size the X-axis motor by peak, speed and RMS torque; the pulley radius trades speed margin for torque margin; output is often limited by loading, not speed.

title: 花样机仿真
Pattern-sewer simulation
goal: 验证每针转速上限 n_max = W/(6t_move) 与针距、布厚的关系。
Verify how the per-stitch limit n_max = W/(6t_move) depends on stitch length and thickness.
观察斜向针与 X、Y 方向针的差别，以及三种运动规律对缝制时间的影响。
Observe the difference between diagonal and axial stitches, and how the three motion laws affect sewing time.
体会前瞻调速怎样避免走不完的针。
See how look-ahead speed control avoids stitches that cannot be completed.
theory: 机头参数：r = 15.5 mm，l = 55 mm，上止点时针尖在针板上方 18 mm；离布窗口由布 + 下模板厚 t 决定，再扣除两端余量。
Head parameters: r = 15.5 mm, l = 55 mm, point 18 mm above the plate at TDC; the window depends on fabric + lower template thickness t, minus end margins.

text: 布加下模板总厚 1.5 mm，离布窗口 W = 203.4°；每轴 a = 50 m/s²，等加速等减速。沿 X 方向针距 4 mm 时，转速上限约为多少 r/min？
Fabric plus lower template is 1.5 mm, window W = 203.4°; a = 50 m/s² per axis, constant acceleration. What is the speed limit for a 4 mm stitch along X, in r/min?
主轴 2400 r/min，X–Y 驱动从发指令到跟上的延迟为 1.2 ms。若不做延迟补偿，模板的动作会滞后多少度主轴转角？
The shaft runs at 2400 r/min and the X–Y drive lags its command by 1.2 ms. Without delay compensation, by how many degrees of shaft angle does the template lag?
feedback: 滞后角 = 6nT_d = 6 × 2400 × 0.0012 ≈ 17.3°，所以要用预测角 φ + ωT_d 查表。
Lag = 6nT_d = 6 × 2400 × 0.0012 ≈ 17.3°, which is why the table is looked up at the predicted angle φ + ωT_d.

text: 条件同上（W = 203.4°，每轴 a = 50 m/s²，X、Y 两轴各自独立受限）。一针长 5 mm、沿 45° 方向，转速上限约为多少 r/min？
Same conditions (W = 203.4°, a = 50 m/s² per axis, each axis limited independently). A 5 mm stitch runs at 45°. What is its speed limit in r/min?
feedback: Each axis moves only 5/√2 ≈ 3.54 mm, t_move ≈ 16.8 ms, n_max ≈ 203.4/(6 × 0.0168) ≈ 2016 r/min, about 19% above a 5 mm stitch along X (about 1695 r/min).

text: 电子凸轮把 X、Y 的位置写成主轴角度的函数，而不是时间的函数，主要是因为：
The electronic cam writes X and Y positions as functions of shaft angle rather than time mainly because:
主轴转速会变，按角度同步时变速不会使模板和机针错位
Shaft speed varies, and angle-based synchronisation keeps template and needle aligned through speed changes
按角度计算比按时间计算更省内存
Angle-based calculation saves memory
编码器只能输出角度，不能计时
The encoder can only output angle, not time
这样就不需要考虑驱动延迟
It removes the need to consider drive delay

feedback: 起针慢、中间快、剪线前慢，负载也会让转速波动；曲线以角度为自变量，变速时形状不变、同步自动成立。驱动延迟仍要用预测角补偿。

Speed is slow at start, fast in the middle, slow before trimming, and fluctuates with load; with angle as the variable the curve keeps its shape and sync holds. Drive delay still needs predicted-angle compensation.

text: 其他条件不变，把运动规律从等加速等减速（C = 4）换成摆线（C = 6.28），转速上限约变为原来的：
All else equal, switching from constant acceleration (C = 4) to a cycloid (C = 6.28) changes the speed limit to about:
0.80 times
0.64 times
1.25 times
不变，因为峰值加速度不变
Unchanged, because peak acceleration is unchanged

feedback: 同样的加速度能力下 Δt 放大 √(6.28/4) ≈ 1.25 倍，转速上限乘 1/1.25 ≈ 0.80；0.64 是忘了开方。
With the same acceleration capability Δt grows by √(6.28/4) ≈ 1.25, so the limit is multiplied by 1/1.25 ≈ 0.80; 0.64 forgets the square root.

text: 关于中压脚的时序，下列说法正确的是：
Which statements about intermediate-presser-foot timing are correct?
必须在机针入布前压下
It must be down before the needle enters the fabric
必须在机针出布后才抬起
It must lift only after the needle leaves the fabric
中压脚抬起以后模板才能移动
The template may move only after the foot has lifted
中压脚压下时模板移动可以减少跳针
Moving the template while the foot is down reduces skipped stitches

feedback: 中压脚在机针上提时压住布面防止布被带起而跳针；它未抬起时移动模板会拖动布料。
The foot holds the fabric as the needle rises so it is not lifted and stitches do not skip; moving the template while it is down drags the fabric.

text: 前瞻调速要做一次反向扫描，是因为主轴每针只能改变有限的转速 Δn，必须为后面的慢针提前减速。
Look-ahead speed control includes a backward pass because the shaft can change speed only by a limited Δn per stitch and must slow down early for slow stitches ahead.
feedback: 主轴连同旋梭有惯量，不能在一针之内从 2680 降到 1198 r/min；反向扫描令 cap[i] ≤ cap[i+1] + Δn。
The shaft and hook have inertia and cannot drop from 2680 to 1198 r/min in one stitch; the backward pass enforces cap[i] ≤ cap[i+1] + Δn.

text: 同步带 EA = 150 kN，滑座两侧带长 L₁ = 0.2 m、L₂ = 0.6 m，X 轴运动质量 2.5 kg。工作台沿 X 方向的固有频率约为多少 Hz？
A belt has EA = 150 kN; the belt lengths either side of the carriage are L₁ = 0.2 m and L₂ = 0.6 m, and the X-axis moving mass is 2.5 kg. What is the natural frequency along X, in Hz?
X 轴运动质量 4 kg，要求 a = 40 m/s²，导轨 μ = 0.05，带轮节圆半径 12 mm，电机转子惯量 0.3×10⁻⁴ kg·m²。所需峰值转矩约为多少 N·m？（g = 9.8 m/s²）
The X axis moves 4 kg at a = 40 m/s², rail μ = 0.05, pulley pitch radius 12 mm, rotor inertia 0.3×10⁻⁴ kg·m². What peak torque is needed, in N·m? (g = 9.8 m/s²)
花样文件用“相对上一针的整数增量（单位 0.1 mm）”而不用浮点绝对坐标，主要原因是：
Pattern files store integer increments from the previous stitch (in 0.1 mm) rather than floating-point absolute coordinates mainly because:
数据紧凑，累加不会产生舍入误差
Data are compact and summing them accumulates no rounding error
机器无法处理负数坐标
The machine cannot handle negative coordinates
增量格式可以不需要原点
An incremental format needs no origin
整数运算可以让工作台走得更快
Integer arithmetic makes the table move faster

text: 一段花样以 2 mm 针距稳定运行在 2680 r/min，第 5 针是 10 mm 的长针，自身上限 1198 r/min；每针允许转速变化 Δn = 250 r/min。按前瞻算法，第 3 针的转速是多少 r/min？

A section runs steadily at 2680 r/min with 2 mm stitches; stitch 5 is a 10 mm stitch with its own limit of 1198 r/min; Δn = 250 r/min per stitch. By the look-ahead algorithm, what is the speed of stitch 3 in r/min?
feedback: Backward pass: stitch 4 = 1198 + 250 = 1448, stitch 3 = 1698, stitch 2 = 1948, stitch 1 = 2198.

text: 布加下模板总厚 3 mm（W = 192.6°），每轴 a = 60 m/s²，等加速等减速。沿 X 方向针距 2.5 mm 时转速上限约为多少 r/min？
Fabric plus lower template is 3 mm (W = 192.6°), a = 60 m/s² per axis, constant acceleration. What is the speed limit for a 2.5 mm stitch along X, in r/min?
feedback: t_move = 2√(0.0025/60) ≈ 12.9 ms; n_max = 192.6/(6 × 0.0129) ≈ 2486 r/min (below a 2800 r/min head limit, so the table governs).

text: X 轴电机每针移动时转矩为 ±2.0 N·m，静止时接近零，移动时间占一针周期的 50%。均方根转矩约为多少 N·m？
An X-axis motor delivers ±2.0 N·m while moving and nearly zero at rest, moving for 50% of each stitch period. What is the RMS torque in N·m?
feedback: T_rms ≈ T_peak √(占比) = 2.0 × √0.5 ≈ 1.41 N·m；发热看均方根转矩，要与额定转矩比较。
T_rms ≈ T_peak √(fraction) = 2.0 × √0.5 ≈ 1.41 N·m; heating is judged by RMS torque against the rated torque.

text: 花样机控制器允许启动缝纫必须同时满足的条件有：
Which conditions must all hold before a pattern-sewer controller allows sewing to start?
压框到位信号有效
The clamp-in-position signal is valid
气压正常
Air pressure is normal
安全光幕无遮挡
The light curtain is clear
主轴转速已达到最高转速
The shaft has reached top speed

feedback: 三个条件同时满足才允许启动，缝纫中任一失效，主轴立即停在上针位；这些判断不能只放在界面层，还要硬件独立切断。
All three must hold to start; if any fails while sewing, the shaft stops at needle-up at once. These checks must not live only in the UI; hardware must also cut independently.

text: 剪线电磁铁线圈 R = 5 Ω、L = 25 mH，吸合需要 2.5 A。用 60 V 过压启动，从通电到电流达到 2.5 A 需要多少毫秒？
A trimming-solenoid coil has R = 5 Ω and L = 25 mH and needs 2.5 A to pull in. With a 60 V overdrive, how many milliseconds does the current take to reach 2.5 A?
feedback: τ = L/R = 5 ms, steady current 60/5 = 12 A; t = −5 × ln(1 − 2.5/12) ≈ 1.17 ms.
